official_document_review.facts_and_recommendations: Official native installer supports Linux/WSL and explicit version or stable/latest channel. Use inside WSL. Native runtime does not require Node. Latest is the default channel; stable intentionally lags. Preserve accepted latest pin until a deliberate channel decision.

Use native /login, saved native credentials and /status. macOS uses Keychain; Linux credential file has restricted permissions. Credentials must refresh for unattended sessions. API-key environment settings can override subscription auth, especially -p; check effective route without exposing secrets.

Supported fields: model: inherit, tools, disallowedTools, maxTurns, isolation: worktree, optional memory. Omitted effort inherits. Per-call model overrides inheritance. maxTurns returns partial output; custom/general-purpose agents support ID-based continuation. Explore/Plan are one-shot. Worktree starts at default branch; verify intended base. Omit memory to avoid automatic durable memory. Excluding Edit/Write does not constrain Bash/MCP side effects. A newly created agents directory needs a fresh session.

Keep task skills concise and loaded only when relevant. context: fork starts an isolated subagent without conversation history; background defaults true, with narrower built-in tools. A user-only skill uses disable-model-invocation: true. Full preloaded skills consume context; skill permissions and instruction lifetimes differ.

Noninteractive -p supports structured output. Resume by exact session ID for coordinated work; --continue can select the most recent session. Native resume retains continuity without a separate transcript replay layer.

Preserve native prompt caching and compaction. /usage main prompt-cache statistics exclude subagents; whole-workflow savings require worker usage too. /context identifies context overhead. Use focused delegation, small teams, concise skills and bounded tool output. Experimental agent teams add independent contexts and are disabled by default. No vendor percentage is evidence for this workload.
Give workers an executable acceptance check and require evidence before success. Delegate independent research with concise findings; use a bounded review pass instead of recursive model review.
Metal acceleration is supported; Linux GPU support is driver/hardware dependent. A connected host is not a qualified GPU workload.

measurement_proposal.comparison: Same repository revision, task, model, effort and correctness gates; compare native baseline against one added retrieval or worker feature at a time.
metrics: main and worker input/output/cache-read/cache-write tokens where provided
